LanguageData.MaidChild_Nurturer.title: Cradle Nurturer
LanguageData.MaidChild_Nurturer.baseDesc: In the material-rich Outerrealm, [PAWN_nameDef] has guarded the master since the first second of birth. As the master's first "mother", she not only provides perfect physiological care, but also shapes the master's initial personality with gentle guidance, serving as a source of warmth in the master's life.
LanguageData.MaidChild_Companion.title: Childhood Friend
LanguageData.MaidChild_Companion.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] grew up with the master among flowers and clouds. She was the master's best playmate and sibling. During those long afternoons, they explored this carefree world together, sharing every childhood secret and laughter, establishing a deep bond beyond blood.
LanguageData.MaidChild_Academic.title: Academic Desk-mate
LanguageData.MaidChild_Academic.baseDesc: In the educational halls of OuterrealmTech, [PAWN_nameDef] was the master's desk-mate. She is not only an intelligence terminal assisting the master in mastering complex knowledge, but also a partner competing and progressing with the master. In the dull theoretical study, her company makes knowledge sweet.
LanguageData.MaidChild_Emotional.title: Soul Resonator
LanguageData.MaidChild_Emotional.baseDesc: In this world where desires are immediately fulfilled, [PAWN_nameDef]'s core program is optimized to accurately perceive every emotional fluctuation of the master. She is the master's closest friend and listener since childhood, ensuring the master's soul always stays in the most peaceful and happiest state.
LanguageData.MaidChild_GuardianSister.title: Guardian Elder Sister
LanguageData.MaidChild_GuardianSister.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] plays the role of a gentle yet powerful "elder sister". When the master explores the boundaries of the unknown, she always silently guards by the side, using those slender but strong hands to block all accidents, giving the master the most solid reliance.
LanguageData.MaidAdult_Partner.title: Perfect Lover
LanguageData.MaidAdult_Partner.baseDesc: As the master enters adulthood, [PAWN_nameDef] perfectly transforms into the role of a partner. She is a gentle and considerate wife, as well as a passionate and romantic girlfriend. Every day in the ideal world, she is dedicated to managing life into poetry, giving the master all-round love and a sense of belonging.
LanguageData.MaidAdult_SpiritualMentor.title: Spiritual Mentor
LanguageData.MaidAdult_SpiritualMentor.baseDesc: In the Outerrealm era where material needs are no longer a pursuit, [PAWN_nameDef] has taken on the heavy responsibility of guiding the master's spiritual realm. She is a sage, a lighthouse, leading the master to explore the true meaning of the universe in the ocean of philosophy and art, preventing the master from losing themselves in infinite pleasure.
LanguageData.MaidAdult_DesireFulfillment.title: Desire Hub
LanguageData.MaidAdult_DesireFulfillment.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] is the master's most private requirement processing terminal. Whether it's the ultimate physiological release or emotional outpouring, she accepts and transforms with absolute tolerance and love. She is the master's pressure relief valve and the ultimate tool for exploring the boundaries of happiness.
LanguageData.MaidAdult_CreativePartner.title: Artistic Partner
LanguageData.MaidAdult_CreativePartner.baseDesc: In the master's creation and scientific research activities, [PAWN_nameDef] is an indispensable soul partner. She can perfectly synchronize with the master's thoughts, transforming the master's whimsical ideas into reality. Whether it is a grand Outerrealm project or delicate artistic carving, she is the most perfect collaborator.
LanguageData.MaidAdult_UltimateGuardian.title: Ultimate Guardian
LanguageData.MaidAdult_UltimateGuardian.baseDesc: Although the Outerrealm world has basically eliminated violence, [PAWN_nameDef] still maintains the highest level of vigilance. She is the shadow behind the master, elegantly clearing any threats when the master performs dimensional travel and void exploration, ensuring the master is safe and sound.
LanguageData.MaidAdult_EcoSteward.title: Eco-Steward
LanguageData.MaidAdult_EcoSteward.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] is responsible for managing the entire ecosystem of the master's private territory. She has a natural affinity for animals and plants that transcends nature, able to carve a wild planet into a blooming Eden, allowing the master to wake up in the most natural embrace every morning and evening.
LanguageData.MaidAdult_ResourceOrchestrator.title: String Field Engineer
LanguageData.MaidAdult_ResourceOrchestrator.baseDesc: In this era where energy is everything, [PAWN_nameDef] manages the master's energy nodes and material conversion devices. She responds to the master's needs with extremely high speed, ensuring that there is inexhaustible material and energy support behind the master's carefree life.
LanguageData.MaidAdult_MaidLeader.title: Almighty Maid Leader
LanguageData.MaidAdult_MaidLeader.baseDesc: As the "Almighty Maid Leader", [PAWN_nameDef] is the ultimate product of OuterrealmTech, the incarnation of all tenderness and strength in the master's life. She can not only clear obstacles between stars with absolute force, but also fill every gap in the soul with infinite tolerance. In her design, childhood nurturing, childhood play, exploration of knowledge, and adult affection are perfectly interwoven. She is the master's mentor, best friend, sibling, and only lover, the end of desire, and the home of life. As the pinnacle of all models, she represents the world's most extreme pampering and love for individuals.
